\section*{Question 1}

An object moving along a curve in the \(x y\)-plane has position \((x(t), y(t))\) at time \(t \geq 0\) with
\[
\frac{d x}{d t}=12 t-3 t^{2} \text { and } \frac{d y}{d t}=\ln \left(1+(t-4)^{4}\right) .
\]
At time \(t=0\), the object is at position (-13, 5). At time \(t=2\), the object is at point \(P\) with \(x\)-coordinate 3.
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] Find the acceleration vector at time \(t=2\) and the speed at time \(t=2\).
\item[(b)] Find the \(y\)-coordinate of \(P\).
\item[(c)] Write an equation for the line tangent to the curve at \(P\).
\item[(d)] For what value of \(t\), if any, is the object at rest? Explain your reasoning.
\item[(a)] \(x^{\prime \prime}(2)=0, y^{\prime \prime}(2)=-\frac{32}{17}=-1.882\)
\[
a(2)=\langle 0,-1.882\rangle
\]
Speed \(=\sqrt{12^{2}+(\ln (17))^{2}}=12.329\) or 12.330
\item[(b)] \(y(t)=y(0)+\int_{0}^{t} \ln \left(1+(u-4)^{4}\right) d u\)
\[
y(2)=5+\int_{0}^{2} \ln \left(1+(u-4)^{4}\right) d u=13.671
\]
\item[(c)] At \(t=2\), slope \(=\frac{\frac{d y}{d t}}{\frac{d x}{d t}}=\frac{\ln (17)}{12}=0.236\)
\[
y-13.671=0.236(x-3)
\]
\item[(d)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
& x^{\prime}(t)=0 \text { if } t=0,4 \\
& y^{\prime}(t)=0 \text { if } t=4 \\
& t=4
\end{aligned}
\]
\end{itemize}
\(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { acceleration vector } \\ 1: \text { speed }\end{array}\right.\)
\begin{itemize}
\item[] \(3:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \int_{0}^{2} \ln \left(1+(u-4)^{4}\right) d u \\ 1: \text { handles initial condition } \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { slope } \\ 1: \text { equation }\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { reason } \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\end{itemize}
